definition: Share of session participants who complete a real task from their own work in the session AND answer yes to 'Did this help you do something you needed to do?'
numerator: participants in the stratum who completed a real task and answered yes
denominator: participants in the stratum who attempted a real task
strata_rule: strata never averaged: transitioning federal/state staff; early-career; corps alumni; seasonal/fire; cross-actor movers; HR/training staff; employee-organization representatives; a stratum with fewer than 5 participants is reported as insufficient, not as a pass
data_source: moderated usability sessions on the release candidate
collection_method: IRB-reviewed sessions run by the research partner; persona tasks from personas.md as revised by the real panel; no in-tool telemetry
privacy_rule: aggregates only; no person-level data reaches the Steward (ADR-0012 I-1); research partner returns stratum counts (n>=5)
when_measured: each research round; final at pilot close (Jan-Feb 2028)
cosign_status: proposed; WVP to co-sign before pilot start

definition: Share completing three core tasks unaided (find my role's craft blend; find my gap to a target role in another sector actor; find a learning or credential action) plus System Usability Scale
numerator: participants completing all three tasks unaided
strata_rule: reported by stratum; thresholds apply overall
privacy_rule: aggregates only; no person-level data reaches the Steward (ADR-0012 I-1)

definition: Share of pilot organizations that put EMST IDs (with release) into at least one real gate artifact (posting, JD/PD, class spec, IDP, training plan, assessment, grant report) within six months of kickoff; repeat use = a second artifact or a second use of the same template
numerator: organizations with >=1 verified artifact carrying EMST IDs
data_source: artifact log: de-identified copies submitted under the MOU; artifact registry (ADR-0023 s2); commitment register gate_artifact field
collection_method: coordinator verifies each artifact against the release IDs

metric: Pathway view validated or labelled exploratory
definition: Pathways view is either validated (AUC >=0.70 against observed moves on held-out data AND beats the best naive baseline by >=0.05) or every pathway is labelled exploratory with no recommendation
threshold: pass = validated, or labelled exploratory throughout; fail = any pathway labelled recommended without validation
strata_rule: validation reported by craft cluster and actor pair
data_source: observed transitions as aggregate edges (from-variant, to-variant, year, region bucket, n>=5) from partner states and the federal-to-state placement work; research-partner-held consented histories
privacy_rule: aggregate edges only, n>=5 (ADR-0012 I-1 s4)

metric: Friction register complete for pre-registered pathways
definition: Share of pre-registered pathway x actor-pair cells with documented FrictionRecords (minimum types in vocab/friction_types.yaml), each with source and asOf
collection_method: authored by CM with FH, SL, PS, DB; Tribal frictions are not defined by CM

definition: Accessibility conformance of every pilot-facing view and kit at WCAG 2.2 AA (superset of Section 508 WCAG 2.0 AA and ADA Title II WCAG 2.1 AA) and a privacy review confirming no personal data is collected, stored or transmitted
threshold: pass (ACR signed; privacy applicability statement signed)
data_source: accessibility conformance report; security and privacy packet
collection_method: axe/Lighthouse plus manual review; CP signs in Phase 4, the Steward thereafter
privacy_rule: no network request carries user-entered data
pending: CM M-05 text names WCAG 2.1 AA; superseded by WCAG 2.2 AA per ADR-0027

definition: Number of federal agencies and of state agencies with a signed agreement in the commitment register that names a use case, an artifact and data-sharing terms
unit_of_analysis: agency (sub-agency or bureau counts separately only if it signs separately)
numerator: agencies with status signed or active and role design-partner-federal / design-partner-state / shadow-user
collection_method: computed from the register; never typed

definition: Documented uses of EMST outputs to rank, select or remove staff, or in RIF or adverse action, without an adopted use policy and worker notice
threshold: 0; any incident pauses expansion pending review
data_source: WVP and employee-organization channel; partner attestations at close-out
collection_method: reports investigated by the Steward with the WVP; outcome recorded in docs/decisions

definition: Panel vote on closing G1, with stratum quorum
threshold: majority within EVERY stratum; any stratum objection requires a written response before the gate closes; override only by written answer, second vote and escalation (charter Art. 4.6)
strata_rule: S-H counted only once filled through the Tribal gate
collection_method: plenary vote after the sensemaking workshop
privacy_rule: votes recorded by stratum without names

definition: Share of roles requested by pilot users and shadow users that exist in EMST as a role profile with the needed sector-actor variant
Pilot organizations completing the pilot (close-out evidence pack submitted)

metric: Willingness to continue without full stipend
definition: Pilot organizations that sign a written commitment to continued use in the following year with a reduced or no stipend
numerator: organizations with a signed continuation entry in the register

definition: Pilot organizations taking a sentinel-network or advisory role (rung 5) with a register entry
numerator: organizations with a signed rung-5 entry

definition: Months of Stage 2 funding secured or committed in writing for the core programme, from the G1 date
numerator: months covered by signed funder or public agreements in the register

metric: Credible contribution story for higher cross-actor hire rates
definition: On pre-registered pathways, the share of hires whose prior employer was a different sector actor rises relative to comparison units (difference-in-differences), with a documented artifact chain, and the contribution story is rated credible by the external reviewer and the panel
threshold: increase vs comparison units >= pre-registered minimum detectable effect AND contribution story rated credible
strata_rule: reported by pathway; never pooled to hide a failing pathway
data_source: partner HR aggregates; state HR prior-federal-employment fields; OPM FWD accessions; research-partner-held consented histories
collection_method: contribution analysis (logic model s5) with rival-explanation checks X1-X8
privacy_rule: aggregate counts n>=5 computed by partners (ADR-0012 I-1 s4)

metric: Movers at parity on time-to-productivity and retention
definition: Supervisor-rated weeks to full performance and 12-month retention of cross-actor hires compared with internal hires on the same pathways
threshold: no worse than internal hires on both measures
strata_rule: reported by pathway and entry path
data_source: partner HR aggregates; structured 90-day supervisor check-ins aggregated by the partner

definition: Gaps in application, hire, time-to-productivity and retention rates by demographic group (with consent), entry path (seasonal, corps, apprenticeship, degree or no degree), veteran status and rural or urban location
threshold: no widening of any gap vs baseline; early-career, seasonal and corps strata at parity
strata_rule: reported by group; suppressed below n=5
collection_method: partners compute gap statistics inside their own systems and return only aggregate gaps; EMST never receives individual demographic data
privacy_rule: aggregate gap statistics only; suppression below 5
pending: CM M-17 data source names consented partner HR; implemented as partner-computed aggregates under ADR-0012

metric: EMST IDs in live gate artifacts at federal agencies and states, with crosswalk coverage
definition: Number of federal agencies and of states with EMST IDs in live PDs, class specs, postings or assessments; crosswalk coverage of targeted OPM series and state classes
threshold: >=2 federal agencies AND >=5 states; >=80% crosswalk coverage of targeted series and classes
data_source: artifact registry; commitment register; L6 crosswalk build

definition: Every entry role profile on a pilot pathway keeps at least the threshold number of formation tasks after current AI adoption, or carries a documented mitigation (apprenticeship, deliberate formation tasks, by-hand quotas)
numerator: entry variants at or above threshold or mitigated
data_source: L2 tasks and L5 assessments (computed CLD at role level)
collection_method: computed by CI from stored assessments
pending: threshold N set by IO/LC in WP-07/WP-11
